description: This file defines the 'UpgradeCommand' class, which is a command-line utility for upgrading the OrangeHRM system. It handles user input for database credentials, performs system checks, manages upgrade steps, executes database migrations, and creates configuration files.

classes.name: UpgradeCommand
classes.description: A command-line utility class for managing the upgrade process of the OrangeHRM system. Handles user input validation, system checks, executing database migrations, and creating configuration files.

methods.name: getCommandName
methods.description: Returns the command identifier, setting aliases to 'upgrade'.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Defines and adds command-line options for database credentials and version information.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main method to execute upgrade process: collects user input, performs system checks, runs migrations, and creates configuration files.

methods.name: drawDatabaseInfoTable
methods.description: Displays a table summarizing database connection details.

methods.name: hasOption
methods.description: Checks if a command-line option is provided and not empty.

methods.name: throwIfParamEmpty
methods.description: Throws an exception if a required parameter is missing or empty.
